content:
Implementation of Phase 38 (Gatekeeper Pre-checks, 3.2.0) on branch `phase-38-gatekeeper-pre-checks` — commits d90c067 + 5af49e8. Full suite: 1084 passed, 5 skipped.

WHAT LANDED (per the approved plan, sections A–J):
- `tagteam/gatekeeper.py` (new): `GateSpec`/`resolve_gatekeeper`/`load_spec`; checks in the fixed order scope (FROZEN first) → plan-doc → tests (`_run_command`: shell string / list, stderr merged, `TAGTEAM_GATE=1`, process-group kill on timeout, tail = last `max_output_chars`, full output to `.tagteam/gates/<stem>.log`); `decide` (fail→BOUNCE; cap → `GATE: checks failed but bounce cap (N) reached — reviewer, see report` + PASS-WITH-FINDINGS line); `consecutive_bounces` (trailing GATE_BOUNCE among gate entries); `run_gate` = peek decided → slot-first claim (kind=gate; SlotBusy → `deferred`, no DB row) → locked sweep+claim (`db.claim_gate`, ≤2 attempts; refused → release slot and branch on the persisted decision / live-other / attempts-exhausted PASS-with-findings) → checks outside the lock → locked `cycle.ensure_gate_applied` + row finish in the same hold → slot released on every path (finally). `sweep_abandoned_gates` (reconcile-from-entry first, then dead pid / identity mismatch / timeout+grace without matching slot marker → abandoned; unverifiable kept + reported), `gate_status`, `last_gate_summary`, `gate_command` (check|run|status|list, --json).
- `cycle.py`: `ROLE_GATEKEEPER`, `GATE_PASS/GATE_BOUNCE`; `capture_impl_boundary` (HEAD sha + sha256 of every dirty/untracked path, `--untracked-files=all`) captured in `add_round` on a plan-cycle APPROVE (rulings go through add_round → covered), copied at impl init (`copied-from-plan`), read file-first via `read_impl_boundary`; `compute_impl_work` (rules a/b/c + artifact & plan-artifact exclusions, `ImplWorkUnavailable` → skip); `ensure_gate_applied` (entry-first idempotent under the writer lock: never a second entry per `gate_event`; PASS = rounds + shadow DB + export only, seq unchanged; BOUNCE = compare-and-apply on (phase,type,round,submission_seq): applied once with `applied_seq`, `already`, or `superseded`; a FRESH decision for a moved submission writes nothing); `read_rounds_file` (canonical file, all keys); renderers label `### Gatekeeper`.
- `db.py`: schema v8 — `gates` table + `uq_gates_running` / `uq_gates_decided`, `claim_gate` (BEGIN IMMEDIATE INSERT…SELECT WHERE NOT EXISTS decided/running AND max(attempt) < max_attempts), `finish_gate`/`update_gate`/`gates_for_event`/`decided_gate_for_event`/`gates_for_cycle`/`last_gate`/`running_gates`/`unfinished_gates`; `gates` in NON_FILE_BACKED_TABLES; `_ACTION_TO_STATUS` GATE_*; VALID_ROLES/ACTIONS widened.
- `config.py`: `GATEKEEPER_KEYS`, `validate_gatekeeper_config`, `get_gatekeeper_spec` (briefer pattern, unknown keys rejected).
- `watcher.py`: `_maybe_gate` at the `_handle_ready` seam for turn==reviewer in all four modes (PASS falls through to the existing hand-off in the same tick; BOUNCE returns; deferred/error/not-ready latch `_gate_owed_seq`; stale never dispatches); the same-seq branch of `tick()` re-enters `_dispatch` while the latch matches (pause respected); spec resolved in `_build_processor` (problems warn + disable); startup banner line.
- `headless.py`: `SLOT_KIND_GATE`. `cli.py`: `gate` dispatch + help. Cockpit: `now_payload.gatekeeper {enabled,on,last}`, feed kind `gate`/`gate bounce`, `chip-gate` in the Now strip. Docs: SKILL (both copies identical — line-61 delta reconciled; lead pre-flight + reviewer note), README "Gatekeeper" subsection + CLI ref, HTW `#gatekeeper` section + files table, roadmap. `pyproject.toml`/`CITATION.cff` → 3.2.0.
- Tests: `tests/test_gatekeeper.py` (96): config; boundary matrix (plan-only fails / code passes / impl-doc passes / unborn HEAD / dirty-unchanged → committed-identical → modified / deletion / untracked-dir growth / legacy skip / no-git skip); checks (scope frozen before a file-creating test command, truncation, timeout kill, log, pytest summary, list form); decide + cap; run_gate (pass/bounce/decided-not-rerun/not-applicable/not-ready/stale/slot-busy/live-other/superseded-on-AMEND/error/attempts-exhausted/cap/manual); ensure_gate_applied double-call no-ops; fault matrix (a)–(g); sweep matrix incl. concurrent reclaim; watcher: PASS same-tick hand-off + BOUNCE no-dispatch in notify/tmux/iterm2/headless, gate-owed latch busy→free on identical ticks in all four modes, pause interplay, restart mid-gate, disabled byte-identical, PASS write semantics across restart, contained gate error, `_build_processor`; CLI; cockpit payloads/assets; render labels; SKILL copies; flag-off full cycle. Plus `test_db.py` v8 (v7→v8 rebuild keeps ids, claim/attempt cap, uq_gates_decided, snapshot/restore) and `test_cockpit_api.py`.

DEVIATIONS FROM THE PLAN TEXT (recorded in the plan under "Implementation notes"): (1) v8 rebuilds `rounds` in place — same columns/ids/index — to widen the v1 `role IN ('lead','reviewer')` CHECK (the first dogfood tripped DB_INVALID on it); (2) `impl_boundary` lives on the status FILE only (no cycle column) and the gate's entry keys are read from the canonical JSONL (`read_rounds_file`), because the DB-first views drop them; the key is written only when non-null so flag-off status files stay byte-identical (parity corpus unchanged); (3) an AMEND (rounds-only, no seq bump) supersedes a decision through a pinned round-log length (`pre_entries`); the same event key re-runs as attempt 2; (4) `run_gate` treats a caller's older seq as `stale` and `not-ready` as no-dispatch; (5) no `verify_transition` GATE_BOUNCE branch needed (gate entries are role gatekeeper, never the verified agent's action).

DOGFOOD: real `tagteam watch --mode notify` on a scratch git project — round 1 (tests failing) → `GATE: BOUNCE`, `turn: lead`, `updated_by: Gatekeeper`, seq+1, reviewer NOT notified, lead notified next tick; fix + re-submit r2 → `GATE: PASS` in the same tick, reviewer notified, seq unchanged; `tagteam gate list` shows bounce (applied_seq=4) + pass. `tagteam gate check` exit 1/0 with the same report. This repo's own tagteam.yaml is NOT changed (plan: no auto-enable; and this phase's plan was approved before the boundary existed → scope would skip) — suggest enabling it for Phase 39+.
